name: Hòn Tằm
kicker: The island beach and the water sports
summary: Island beach 7 km out: swim the sand and ride the water sports on a boat day off the city. The shore is white sand and palms, with calm water and Hoàng Hoa village and its old houses. Boats leave the island harbor through the day. The scenic fee for this crossing is 8,000 VND.
dotReason: A boat day for a quieter island beach and the water sports, beside the city sand rather than instead of it.
heroCaption: The palm shore and the swim beach on Hòn Tằm

notice.title: The scenic fee is not the resort ticket
notice.body: The crossing is 8,000 VND a person, plus 3,000 VND at the pier. A beach chair, a flyboard, or a resort day is a separate ticket.

body: Hòn Tằm is the island beach 7 km from Nha Trang: white sand, palms, tropical forest, calm water, and water sports. Boats leave the island harbor through the day. Swim first. The flyboard and the jet ski are the loud half of the same shore.

Hoàng Hoa village is the quiet half: old houses, period furniture, and festivals of music, dance, food, and crafts. The scenic fee for this route is 8,000 VND a person each crossing. That fee does not buy the sports.

figures.caption: A flyboard and a jet ski off the island
figures.alt: A person on a flyboard beside a red jet ski in the water at Hòn Tằm

gettingThere: Hòn Tằm is 7 km from Nha Trang, and boats leave the island harbor through the day. The scenic fee is paid for the crossing from the inland pier. The boat fare is separate.

legs.heading: From the inland pier
legs.body: Pay the 8,000 VND Hòn Tằm scenic fee and the 3,000 VND pier charge, then the boat. Collection points are Bến tàu Du lịch Nha Trang and Bến thủy nội địa Phú Quý.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: Ride to the boat pier, then cross. The island is 7 km out.

hours: Boats leave the island harbor through the day.
admissionNote: The resort and the water sports are separate from the scenic fee. The Hòn Tằm route is 8,000 VND a person each crossing, plus 3,000 VND for the pier. The fee excludes accident insurance. Children under 6 and Khánh Hòa residents are among those exempt. A child from 6 to under 16 pays half.
